referenceRadiusMeaning: Equivalent-volume radius computed from the original closed triangular mesh; not an independent measurement.
shapeLimit: Published radar shape of the smaller, inner moon. Fine terrain and visible-light color are unresolved; the grid marks missing imagery. The archive includes weakly observed model regions. The model assumes the primary’s spin pole for this moon. Rotational phase is illustrative.
orbitLimit: Orbital placement is approximate context extrapolated from the 2008 mutual-orbit fit. Current phase and long-term three-body evolution are not measured.
physicalSource: Becker et al. (2015), Table 4; physical API row order is not used.
